notes.title: Version 2 is published!
notes.content:
What has changed?

-Heart icons have been changed
-The starting points have been made clear (Flag added)
-Camera switching icon
- With the "Shift" key, the game speeds up, but time passes faster.
-Health gain feature
-Some levels of voices have changed
-Sound imbalances have been reduced
The voice of leaving has changed
-Small UI changes
-New effects (Sand etc.)
-Lose ball bursting effect, sound
-The times given in the game have been reorganized
- "Time is Running Out" warning (Time bar turns red, clock sound starts to ring)
-Safe zone has been added to the beginning in hard mode
-Translation corrections
-Sound has been added to some levels, the levels without sound are now only the levels in the space.

-Minor bugs fixed
